note: Fresh compose set for the scoreboard fixture library, written and labelled before composeRecipe existed. expect is the set of parts a designer would place for the parts the request names; [] when nothing fits (no-fit or typo-heavy). composed is false when fewer than 2 parts fit. tune rows may guide fixes; heldout rows are only measured, never tuned on. Slot precision: returned parts that are expected. Slot recall: expected parts that were returned. Invented: a returned id that is not a live master in the graph.
